_source.title: 新增网络事件监听
_source.remarks.text.1: ①在过滤面板选中网络选项并在画布选中网络时
_source.remarks.text.2: ②在工程设计 -\> 网络内选中网络时
_source.remarks.text.4: 注意：本接口仅扩展有效，在独立脚本环境内调用将始终 `throw Error`

title: Add a net event listener
remarks.text.1: 1. When the net option is selected in the filter panel and a net is selected on the canvas
remarks.text.2: 2. When a net is selected in Engineering Design -> Nets
remarks.text.4: Note: This API is only valid for extensions. Calling it in a standalone script environment will always `throw Error`
params.id: Event ID, used to prevent duplicate event registration
params.callFn: The callback function triggered when the event fires
